mechanism: Sodium valproate can cause hyperammonemia and metabolic acidosis, which may lead to hypokalemia through renal potassium wasting and transcellular shifts; conversely, valproate-induced pancreatitis or hepatotoxicity can impair potassium homeostasis.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly during valproate therapy; supplement potassium if hypokalemia develops and assess renal function and acid-base status periodically.
